description: Use when an agent needs one answer it can act on, not a pile of evidence to weigh: a verdict on any ERC20 on five chains - a machine-readable label for who can act on your balance (no-owner-powers, owner-can-intervene, owner-controls-balances, not-a-token), a headline, a plain reading and a paste-ready card, with the evidence underneath selector by selector. Label and card come from the bytecode and live state, never from a model. Research, not investment advice. $0.02 per call, paid over x402 (USDC).
name: evm_verdict
title: Plain-language verdict on an ERC20, with the evidence under it
